operator.note: Platform operations use the GitHub UI

bots.name: agent-intake
bots.label: agent:intake
bots.description: Turns chat summaries into parent issues and fans out one child issue per repository and outcome. Issues only.

bots.name: agent-generator
bots.label: agent:generator
bots.description: Picks the top queued issue for the focus repository and opens a small pull request. Contents and pull requests only.

bots.name: agent-reviewer
bots.label: agent:reviewer
bots.description: Reads pull requests, checks CI, and posts advisory review comments and labels. Read-only code access.

github_token.note: Repository-scoped; used where cross-repository access is not required

identity_note: Fine-grained PATs act as the account owner; distinct bot authorship requires GitHub Apps
